semantics.operation: Combinational half adder with no carry-in: sum is the low bit and cout the high bit of a+b.
semantics.timing: No clock or cycle latency; outputs follow inputs after combinational settling. Original interface contains no clock.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initial values; binary behavior checked after driving inputs.

verification.oracle: Original half-adder definition, checked using integer arithmetic independent of RTL Boolean expressions.
verification.cases: All four binary input pairs, repeated in reverse order to exercise transitions.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs and wait 1 ns for combinational settling before checking both outputs.
verification.failure: Case inequality and $fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS printed only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z input values is not specified; verification covers the complete binary domain.
